index.html.description: Elikonas is a learner-owned educational record platform for non-traditional learners — a portable, lifelong record of everything you've learned, guided by AI.

blog.html.description: Insights on non-traditional learning, portable credentials, and the future of how skills get recognized — from the Elikonas team.

stories.html.description: Real stories from non-traditional learners building lifelong, portable records of everything they know — outside the traditional degree path.

roadmap.html.description: See what's next for Elikonas — the learner-owned platform giving non-traditional learners a permanent, portable record of their skills.

mission.html.description: Elikonas is a Public Benefit Corporation, legally committed to expanding equitable access to education and workforce development.

careers.html.description: Elikonas isn't hiring yet, but we will be. Tell us you're interested and we'll reach out when there's an opening.

subscribe.html.description: Sign up to hear about Elikonas' progress before you're able to create an account.

governance/index.html.description: Elikonas exists to give every learner a record they can trust — one that belongs to the user, for as long as they want it. Here's how we govern this site.

governance/privacy.html.description: What personal information Elikonas collects, how we use it, and the choices you have about it.

governance/terms.html.description: The agreement between you and Elikonas that governs your use of the website and platform.

governance/community-guidelines.html.description: How we treat each other at Elikonas — what's welcome, what's not, and how we handle concerns.

governance/ai-usage-policy.html.description: How Elikonas uses AI — in the platform and internally — and what we commit to as we do.

governance/sms-terms.html.description: The terms that apply to SMS/text messages sent by Elikonas, including consent, message frequency, and how to opt out.
